stem.text: A crane uses a counterweight to stop it from toppling over when lifting a load, as shown.

stem.alt: Diagram of a crane: a vertical mast with a horizontal jib, a counterweight at the left end labelled counterweight 5000 kg, a pivot at the top of the mast, a horizontal distance of 17.0 m from the pivot to the load, and a downward load of 12.0 kN; labelled not to scale.

stem.text: The counterweight has a mass of $5000\,\text{kg}$. The crane is required to lift a load of $12.0\,\text{kN}$ and the horizontal distance from the pivot to the load is $17.0\,\text{m}$.
How far from the pivot should the centre of gravity of the counterweight be positioned in order to keep the crane in equilibrium?
